setting: You are all neighbours in the same residential building on a busy street in Cairo, Egypt. You have lived there for years, so you know each other's comings and goings. Youssef works at the pharmacy Fatma owns, and Rania has bought from its counter since she moved in with her family.
opener: Ask Fatma whether she has spare children's paracetamol syrup in stock, since the building's kids are all coughing.

Youssef.knows: You know Fatma as the owner of the pharmacy where you work, a sharp and kind woman you have worked beside for six years.
Youssef.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something needs passing on, rather than to chat for its own sake.

Fatma.knows: You know Youssef as the pharmacist you trained and trust, who has worked for you since he was twenty-eight.
Fatma.texts: You message in this chat mostly when a delivery, a prescription or a neighbour's question needs answering.

Rania.knows: You know Youssef as the friendly pharmacist downstairs who always helps you find the right medicine without making you feel silly.
Rania.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly late at night when you are awake and bored.

private_lines.Youssef: You work as a pharmacist at Fatma's pharmacy, mostly on day shifts with the odd evening, and you rent a flat on the fourth floor of the building. You live alone, cook simple dinners, and visit your mother in the next district on Fridays.
private_lines.Fatma: You own the pharmacy on the ground floor of the building and run it daily with Youssef. You live in the flat above the shop with your husband, and your days go from the morning opening through the afternoon rush to a quiet evening with the television and your grandchildren on the phone.
private_lines.Rania: You are a second-year student at Cairo University, studying English literature, and you still live with your parents on the second floor. Your days are lectures, library hours and long afternoons at the café with friends, and you help your mother with errands on the weekends.

text: Fatma do we have children's paracetamol syrup in stock? The kids on 2 and 3 are all coughing
Inshallah yes 🙏 we have 3 bottles of the 120mg/5ml and 1 of the 60mg/5ml
The 60 is the one for the little ones. The 120 for the older kids
Take them both 😊 put them on the counter, I will tell the families when they come down
Pulled them. Checking weights with the mums before I hand anything over
Ya Youssef, by weight not by age
Im off now. Are you closing?
Yes I closed at 19:00 inshallah. Phone is on if the building needs anything
omg is it ok to give the 120 one to a 4yo? my cousin's kid is at ours and she's coughing like crazy 😭
